subsequent_changes: Documentation and this verification record only

supplemental_chrome_journey.scope: Synthetic working-tree run: KO/EN, desktop and 390px, three room modes, actual invitation/check/join, API billing consent and withdrawal, stopped/failed/stale recovery, scope mismatch, read retry and navigation
supplemental_chrome_journey.provenance_limit: Supplemental journey was run during readiness development; final committed stopped-start and missing-contribution-scope behavior is additionally covered by the passing full-suite actual Chrome test.

regressions_verified: stop/deadline still fence ordinary work while one fixed-endpoint terminal status report remains bounded to a 2-second HTTP timeout after runtime shutdown
separate journals cannot reuse a claim idempotency response; response-loss retry retains its own durable key
legacy shared claim_pending/claimed keys fail closed before model execution
a pause, topic generation change or task attempt replacement observed in the latest room snapshot prevents the model call
co_creation requires room:contribute in server start checks, scheduler, credential readiness and UI guide; missing permission leaves a manual room preparing
stopped/failed/stale worker state requires explicit recovery selection; a stopped worker never receives the known-invalid fresh-start command
KO/EN pending invitation names and check/join/connect order are checked against actual Chrome UI
earlier_runs: Initial test-only full run had a heartbeat process-fixture startup failure; the unchanged cleanup test passed in focused reruns and final full validation.
Two crash-recovery fixtures were updated to persist worker-owned random claim keys; explicit legacy-key rejection has separate regression coverage.
limits: Terminal status reporting is best effort: revoked credentials or network failure can still leave a stale observation until expiry; no cleanup path claims remote success without a response.

Latest snapshot validation reduces obsolete calls but cannot make a remote control change after the snapshot atomic with provider execution. Existing server completion fencing and cancellation remain required.
Distinct claim keys prevent accidental cross-journal replay; they are not a new authenticated server-issued lease capability for arbitrary external tool writes.
contracts: No public request fields or database schema were added. Mode-specific permission validation was tightened within the authorized fix scope. ToolBroker API/DB changes remain a proposed follow-up.
provider_and_operating_access: NOTRUN: real provider login/auth/model calls, operating service, private-fixture-host, operating token issuance, deployment and merge
cleanup: Dedicated synthetic browser contexts and fixture servers closed; raw logs and screenshots remain outside the repository.

privacy_redaction.scope: Private test-machine aliases replaced; measurements and outcomes preserved. Original Git history is not rewritten.
